---
title: Set up a CDN resource to follow origin redirects
sidebarTitle: Follow redirects from an origin
description: Configure origin redirects on a CDN resource via the Customer Portal, REST API, or Terraform.
---

import { MethodSwitch, MethodSection } from "/snippets/method-switch.jsx";

<MethodSwitch>
  <MethodSection id="portal" label="Customer Portal">

<p>By default, when the origin returns a redirect, Gcore caches and serves that redirect, while **Redirection from origin** makes the CDN follow selected codes, fetch the target, and cache it instead.</p>

## Redirection from origin

<p>Turn the option on for the redirect codes the CDN should follow.</p>

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the CDN resource">
    In the [Gcore Customer Portal](https://portal.gcore.com), navigate to **CDN** and select the CDN resource.

    <Frame>![CDN resources list](/images/docs/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/set-up-a-cdn-resource-to-follow-origin-redirects/cdn-resources-list.png)</Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Open redirection from origin">
    In the sidebar, under the **Cache** section, select **Redirection from origin**.

    <Frame>![CDN resource settings with Cache section open](/images/docs/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/set-up-a-cdn-resource-to-follow-origin-redirects/cdn-resource-settings-cache.png)</Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Enable origin redirects">
    Enable the **Follow redirect from origin** toggle.

    <Frame>![Follow redirect from origin toggle enabled with status codes field](/images/docs/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/set-up-a-cdn-resource-to-follow-origin-redirects/follow-redirect-enabled.png)</Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Select redirect codes">
    In the **Choose redirect status codes** field, select one or more codes: 301, 302, 303, 307, or 308. Code 302 is selected by default.

    <Frame>![Choose redirect status codes dropdown](/images/docs/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/set-up-a-cdn-resource-to-follow-origin-redirects/redirect-status-codes-dropdown.png)</Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Save the resource">
    Click **Save changes**. Allow at least 15 minutes for the change to take effect.

    <Warning>
      Changing this option can leave a previously cached redirect or target response in cache. [Purge&nbsp;the&nbsp;cache](/cdn/clear-cdn-resource-cache-by-url-pattern-or-all) after saving.
    </Warning>
  </Step>
</Steps>

</MethodSection>
  <MethodSection id="api" label="REST API">

<p>When `follow_origin_redirect` is enabled for a selected status code, the CDN follows it, caches the target response, and serves that content instead of the redirect itself.</p>

<Info>
An [API&nbsp;token](/account-settings/api-tokens) is required.
</Info>

<p>Export these variables. `CDN_RESOURCE_ID` is the `id` from [list&nbsp;CDN&nbsp;resources](/api-reference/cdn/cdn-resources/list-cdn-resources).</p>

```bash
export GCORE_API_KEY="{YOUR_API_KEY}"
export CDN_RESOURCE_ID="{YOUR_RESOURCE_ID}"
```

## Origin redirect option

<p>`codes` accepts 301, 302, 303, 307, 308, and 404. The Customer Portal lists 301, 302, 303, 307, and 308.</p>

<p>`enabled` and `codes` are both required, because an empty `codes` list returns HTTP 400.</p>

<Warning>
Changing this option can leave a previously cached redirect or target response in cache. [Purge&nbsp;the&nbsp;cache](/cdn/clear-cdn-resource-cache-by-url-pattern-or-all) after the update, and allow at least 15 minutes for the change to take effect.
</Warning>

<p>Update the resource with `follow_origin_redirect` enabled for code 302.</p>

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Python SDK">
    ```python
    import os
    from gcore import Gcore

    client = Gcore()

    resource = client.cdn.cdn_resources.update(
        int(os.environ["CDN_RESOURCE_ID"]),
        options={
            "follow_origin_redirect": {"enabled": True, "codes": [302]},
        },
    )
    print(resource.options.follow_origin_redirect.enabled, resource.options.follow_origin_redirect.codes)
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Go SDK">
    ```go
    package main

    import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "os"
        "strconv"

        gcore "github.com/G-Core/gcore-go"
        "github.com/G-Core/gcore-go/cdn"
    )

    func main() {
        client := gcore.NewClient()
        ctx := context.Background()
        resourceID, err := strconv.ParseInt(os.Getenv("CDN_RESOURCE_ID"), 10, 64)
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }

        resource, err := client.CDN.CDNResources.Update(ctx, resourceID, cdn.CDNResourceUpdateParams{
            Options: cdn.CDNResourceUpdateParamsOptions{
                FollowOriginRedirect: cdn.CDNResourceUpdateParamsOptionsFollowOriginRedirect{
                    Enabled: true,
                    Codes:   []int64{302},
                },
            },
        })
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
        fmt.Println(resource.Options.FollowOriginRedirect.Enabled, resource.Options.FollowOriginRedirect.Codes)
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="curl">
    ```bash
    curl -X PATCH "https://api.gcore.com/cdn/resources/$CDN_RESOURCE_ID" \
      -H "Authorization: APIKey $GCORE_API_KEY" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{
        "options": {
          "follow_origin_redirect": {
            "enabled": true,
            "codes": [302]
          }
        }
      }'
    ```

    <p>The API returns HTTP 200:</p>

    ```json
    {
      "id": 12345,
      "options": {
        "follow_origin_redirect": {
          "enabled": true,
          "codes": [302]
        }
      }
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

</MethodSection>
  <MethodSection id="terraform" label="Terraform">

<p>Set `follow_origin_redirect` so the CDN follows selected origin redirect codes, fetches the target, and caches that response instead of the redirect, using the [Terraform&nbsp;provider](/developer-tools/terraform/overview) v2. By default the CDN caches and serves the redirect itself.</p>

<p>`codes` accepts 301, 302, 303, 307, 308, and 404. The Customer Portal lists 301, 302, 303, 307, and 308, and 302 is selected by default. `enabled` and `codes` are both required. An empty `codes` list returns HTTP 400. Leaving `follow_origin_redirect` out of `options` leaves the stored option unchanged. Run `terraform apply` after editing `options`, and allow at least 15 minutes for the change to take effect.</p>

<Warning>
Changing this option can leave a previously cached redirect or target response in cache. [Purge&nbsp;the&nbsp;cache](/cdn/clear-cdn-resource-cache-by-url-pattern-or-all) after the update.
</Warning>

## Follow code 302

<p>Set `enabled` to true and `codes` to 302. The CDN follows that redirect and caches the target response.</p>

```hcl
resource "gcore_cdn_origin_group" "example" {
  name = "my-origin-group"

  sources = [
    {
      source  = "example.com"
      enabled = true
    }
  ]
}

resource "gcore_cdn_resource" "example" {
  cname           = "cdn.example.com"
  origin_group    = gcore_cdn_origin_group.example.id
  origin_protocol = "HTTPS"

  options = {
    follow_origin_redirect = {
      enabled = true
      codes   = [302]
    }
  }
}
```

</MethodSection>
</MethodSwitch>
